MediaStudioSpeech.description: Generate speech locally with Qwen3-TTS using a preset voice, delivery instruction or reference voice. A successful generation does not mean listening review is complete.

mode.name: Generation mode
mode.tooltip: preset uses a preset voice; clone uses a reference recording. Technical enum values stay unchanged.

language.name: Speech language
language.tooltip: Choose the spoken language. Auto detects it automatically.

speaker.name: Preset voice
speaker.tooltip: Choose a preset speaking voice. Voice identifiers stay unchanged.

instruct.name: Delivery instruction
instruct.tooltip: Describe tone, emotion or rhythm for preset voice mode. May be empty.

reference_audio_path.name: Reference audio path
reference_audio_path.tooltip: Local recording path for voice cloning. You can also connect the reference audio input.

reference_text.name: Reference transcript
reference_text.tooltip: The exact words spoken in the reference recording.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Use a fixed seed to compare generated results.

max_new_tokens.name: Maximum generated tokens
max_new_tokens.tooltip: Limits the generation length. A low value may truncate the speech.

timeout_seconds.name: Execution timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.tooltip: Stops external generation processes owned by this node when the limit is exceeded.

reference_audio.name: Reference audio
reference_audio.tooltip: Connect a recording to use as the reference speaking voice.

MediaStudioMV.description: Render an existing local PV project with the original rendering engine. Technical project names stay unchanged.

project_name.name: Existing project
project_name.tooltip: Choose a prepared local project, such as pv-demo.

quality.name: Render quality
quality.tooltip: preview renders a preview; final uses full quality. Technical enum values stay unchanged.

filename_prefix.name: Output filename prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: The technical filename prefix used to save the video.

timeout_seconds.name: Execution timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.tooltip: Stops external rendering processes owned by this node when the limit is exceeded.
